final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT d.A3 AS region, AVG(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN 0 - t.amount ELSE NULL END) AS avg_amt, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM trans t JOIN account a ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id WHERE t.date > '1996-05-09' AND t.date < '1998-01-06' GROUP BY d.A3), s2 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_amt) AS overall FROM s1) SELECT s1.region, s1.avg_amt, s1.cnt, s1.avg_amt * 1.0 / NULLIF(s2.overall, 0) AS ratio FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.overall IS NOT NULL
